policy.rule: Scheduled refreshes may redesign layout, typography, decorative treatment, motion and responsive behavior. They must not alter credential facts. Every new visual must be shown as a demo first and only appended here after explicit approval. Once 30 approved designs exist, reuse them in oldest-first order with at least a 30-day gap.
